message.content: Logistic regression is a statistical method used for binary classification. It models the probability that a given input belongs to one of two classes by applying a logistic (sigmoid) function to a linear combination of the input features. The result is a value between 0 and 1, which can be interpreted as the probability of belonging to the positive class.
